rule: Prefer the lower-latency candidate if its development macro-F1 is within 0.02 of the leader; otherwise investigate deployment of the quality leader before final test evaluation.
measurement_note: Frozen DistilBERT uses four encoder threads; TF-IDF uses one. Timings are local and not a hardware-normalized architecture benchmark.
limitations: Prototype engineering choice, not a bank acceptance criterion. Frozen DistilBERT is not encoder fine-tuning.
